subject: Observability SKU matrix & commitment credits — retention / tracing / dashboards
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.dev>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@stitchtech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.dev>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.dev>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observability SKU matrix & commitment credits — retention / tracing / dashboards

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great to learn more about StitchTech's ingestion profile and the retention SLAs you care about. As promised, I'm attaching a first-pass SKU matrix and a short notes sheet that maps our observability add-ons to volume drivers and expected unit economics. High level summary below so the team has something to react to quickly.

Attachments: [Attachment: observability-sku-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45 KB)]

Quick summary (draft):
- Retention tiers: 30 / 90 / 365 days — billed by GB-month stored.
- Tracing ingestion: per-span ingest unit with optional sampling/ingest-filtering (bulk discounts available at commit thresholds).
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards = seat+query bundle (fixed monthly + per-query uplift for high-cardinality usage).
- Commitment credits: structured as upfront committed GB/month or spans/month with a sliding discount schedule (see matrix).

Question for you: what retention tier do you expect to need for production traces and logs? You mentioned dev vs prod separation in the call — would you want 90d for prod and 30d for dev as a starting point? If you can share a rough monthly GB estimate for logs + estimated spans/day, we can produce a 12-month blended quote with committed vs on-demand lines.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share rough volumes (GB/month logs, spans/day).
2) We produce a blended pricing sheet showing committed discounts at 12-, 24-, 36-month terms.
3) Optional pilot: 3 months of retention at a discounted onboarding rate so you can validate dashboards and routing performance.

If you prefer, Ben (cc'd) can run the cost model and Lauren will approve any deal-level concessions.

Thanks — happy to hop back on a quick call next week to walk the SKU matrix.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.dev | +1 415-555-0121
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@stitchtech.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability SKU matrix & commitment credits — retention / tracing / dashboards

Marcus —

Appreciate the matrix and the quick turnaround. Attaching a rough usage export so you can see our baseline (note: prod ingest tends to spike at end of month).

Attachments: [Attachment: stitchtech_usage_estimate.csv (csv, 12 KB)]

Answers inline:
- Retention: We want 90d for production logs and traces. Dev can be 30d.
- Estimated volumes: baseline logs ~2.5 TB/month, spikes to ~4 TB/month; traces ~8M spans/day baseline, spikes ~15M.
- Contract ask: procurement will push for a minimum 12-month committed spend with a blended price and a slotted discount (we typically ask for an 18–24% discount off list for similar add-ons at our scale).
- Other constraints: we need to preserve proof-of-encryption at rest for retained items (KMS notes), and a short runbook for incident diagnostics — can you confirm those are included in the advanced dashboards add-on?

Also — procurement asked whether there is flexibility on credits for initial overage during onboarding; a 2–3 week headroom on stored GB would help make the pilot realistic. Can you outline how credits or one-time free buffer would look in a commercial proposal?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rios
Head of Platform Engineering, StitchTech
elena.rios@stitchtech.com | +1 617-555-0189

Subject: Re: Observability SKU matrix & commitment credits — retention / tracing / dashboards

Elena — thanks for the volume detail, that helps a lot. I ran a few scenarios with Ben and attached a short pricing summary. High-level proposal below.

Attachments: [Attachment: proposed-pricing-summary.pdf (pdf, 34 KB)]

Proposal (draft, 12-month term example):
- Committed tier A (base) — commit to 2.5 TB logs / 8M spans/day average: 15% discount off list for retention+tracing units; includes 30 GB-month onboarding credit and a one-time 25% discount on first-month dashboard seats.
- Committed tier B (buffer) — commit to 4 TB logs / 15M spans/day: 22% discount off list; includes 90 GB-month onboarding credit and waived setup fee (one-time).
- On-demand overage: billed at list rate with overage breakpoints; we can cap monthly overage at an agreed % for the first 3 months depending on level of commitment.
- Pilot credit option: 6k USD credit applied to observability consumption during initial 60-day pilot (to cover spike risk).

Security / runbook: the advanced dashboards add-on includes a pre-populated diagnostics runbook and indicators for incident triage. KMS-managed encryption at rest is supported — I'll have our security engineer drop in a short note in the commercial appendix.

Next asks from our side to finalize the blended quote:
1) Confirm you want the 12-month term vs 24/36.
2) Confirm which committed tier you prefer (A or B) or whether you want a hybrid.
3) Procurement contact for legal/PO so we can surface any SSO/KMS-specific clauses early.

If you sign off on Tier B, Lauren is comfortable with the proposed concession levels; we'll route to legal for any contract redlines. Happy to set a 30 minute call tomorrow to walk the appendix.

— Marcus
